# FDG5013

> DO NOT have two overloads of a method with “compatible” required parameters that both use default parameters.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.1.1 Member Overloading.

## How it is checked

- Check: fdg (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: FDG5013
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Message: Another overload of '{0}' with compatible required parameters also uses default parameters

FDG5013 reports the later of two overloads in the same type that both have default parameters when a call with only the required arguments of one matches the other: the required parameters of one are, by type and modifier, the leading parameters of the other, and the other needs no more of them. Compatibility through implicit conversions is not checked. There is no code fix; moving the defaults changes the public signatures, so the fix is breaking.
